title: Spinning disk: centrifugal stress from a body-force expression (3D, analytic)
description:
3D static elasticity (solid_mechanics_3d): a steel disk of radius b and thickness 2 t spinning at omega, loaded by the centrifugal body force f = rho omega^2 (x, y) (body_force feature with x, y expressions; the void around the disk, youngs_modulus 0, carries nothing). Quarter of the upper half: the disk axis on the origin corner, rollers on x_lo and y_lo (symmetry planes through the axis) and on z_lo (mid-plane), all other faces free; 1 mm cells, b = 64 cells, t = 6 cells.
Analytic (thin disk, plane stress, Timoshenko; K = rho omega^2): sigma_r = (3 + nu) / 8 K (b^2 - r^2), sigma_t = K / 8 ((3 + nu) b^2 - (1 + 3 nu) r^2), u_r = K r / (8 E) ((3 + nu)(1 - nu) b^2 - (1 - nu^2) r^2); in Cartesian form sigma_xx = K / 8 ((3 + nu)(b^2 - x^2) - (1 + 3 nu) y^2), sigma_yy likewise with x and y swapped, u_x = u_r x / r. Plane stress is the thickness average; at t / b ~ 0.1 the 3D variation through the thickness is ~0.1 %.
Derived values tab: stress_xx_centre (probe in the cell at the axis, sigma_r = sigma_t = 13.3 MPa there), stress_yy_rim (hoop stress in the rim cell on the x axis, K b^2 (1 - nu) / 4) and u_x_rim (rim growth, K b^3 (1 - nu) / (4 E)); expect ~1-3 % (staircase rim, 64 cells per radius). F_x_sym: the x_lo roller reaction balances the body force on the quarter, -K t b^3 / 3 (exact for the voxel disk; the voxel first moment differs from the circle's by ~0.5 %).
Line profile tab (mid-plane layer z = dx / 2, line y = dx / 2 along the x axis): stress_xx, stress_yy and u_x vs the closed forms; largest error in the rim cells.

parameters.name: omega
parameters.description: angular speed in rad/s (rim speed 64 m/s)

parameters.name: t_half
parameters.description: half thickness (the model holds the upper half)

parameters.name: L_side
parameters.description: domain side along x and y (void beyond the rim)

parameters.name: K_spin
parameters.description: centrifugal force per volume and metre of radius, N/m^4

parameters.name: x_rim
parameters.description: x of the rim probe (centre of the last disk cell on the x axis)

parameters.name: y_probe
parameters.description: y of the probes (first cell row)

parameters.name: sxx_centre_ref
parameters.description: analytic sigma_xx at the axis probe (x = y = dx / 2) in Pa

parameters.name: syy_rim_ref
parameters.description: analytic hoop stress sigma_yy at the rim probe in Pa

parameters.name: ux_rim_ref
parameters.description: analytic u_x at the rim probe in m
